# Main Figures

## Fig 2

### Panel A

```{r}
# plot UMAP for both tissues combined
p1 <- UMAPPlot(gex_ART, group.by = "annotated_clusters_all_ref", 
         raster = FALSE, label = FALSE, 
         cols = colorRampPalette(RColorBrewer::brewer.pal(12, "Set1"))(length(levels(gex_ART$annotated_clusters_all_ref)))) + 
  labs(title = NULL) +
  clean_umap

# plot UMAP per tissue
p2 <- UMAPPlot(gex_ART, split.by = "tissue", group.by = "annotated_clusters_all_ref", 
         raster = FALSE, label = FALSE, 
         cols = colorRampPalette(RColorBrewer::brewer.pal(12, "Set1"))(length(levels(gex_ART$annotated_clusters_all_ref)))) + 
  labs(title = NULL) +
  facet_wrap(~ tissue, ncol = 2, labeller = labeller(tissue = c("PBMC" = "Blood"))) +
  clean_umap

# wrap plots
p1 + p2 + plot_layout(widths = c(1, 2.1), guides = "collect")
```

### Panel D

```{r}
# calculate cell frequencies among B cells
B_freq_B <- calculateCellFrequencies(sc_df = gex_B_ART@meta.data, 
                         cluster_col = "annotated_clusters_B",
                         subject_col = "subject_id",
                         vars_to_keep = c("tissue", "HIV_status"),
                         show_clusters = NULL, 
                         denominator_clusters = NULL)
```

```{r}
# Compute the median frequency per cluster and tissue for reordering purposes
cluster_order <- B_freq_B %>% 
  group_by(cluster, tissue) %>% 
  summarize(med_freq = median(frequency), .groups = "drop")

# Compute cell counts per cluster, tissue, and HIV_status, and assign y positions.
label_data <- B_freq_B %>% 
  group_by(cluster, tissue, HIV_status) %>% 
  summarize(n_cells = sum(cell_count), .groups = "drop") %>%
  left_join(cluster_order, by = c("cluster", "tissue")) %>%
  mutate(y_position = ifelse(HIV_status == "control", -0.04, -0.08))

# plot frequencies for PBMC
p4A <- ggplot(B_freq_B %>% dplyr::filter(tissue == "PBMC"), aes(x = tidytext::reorder_within(cluster, -frequency, tissue,FUN = median), y = frequency, fill = HIV_status)) +
  geom_boxplot(position = position_dodge(width = 0.8), width = 0.7, outlier.shape = NA) +
  geom_jitter(aes(color = "black"), position = position_dodge(width = 0.8), alpha = 1) +
  #ggpubr::stat_compare_means(aes(group = HIV_status), method = "wilcox.test", label = "p.signif", hide.ns = TRUE) +
  geom_text(data = label_data %>% dplyr::filter(tissue == "PBMC"), aes(x = tidytext::reorder_within(cluster, -med_freq, tissue, FUN = median), 
                                   y = y_position, label = paste(n_cells), color = HIV_status, fontface = "bold"),
            inherit.aes = FALSE, hjust = 0.5, size = 4, check_overlap = TRUE) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = col_HIV_status, labels = c("PWH" = "PWH", "control" = "PWoH")) +
  scale_color_manual(values = col_HIV_status_PCA, guide = "none") +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::label_percent(scale = 100), breaks = seq(0, 1, 0.2), expand = expansion(mult = c(0.1, 0.1))) +
  tidytext::scale_x_reordered() +
  labs(x = "Cluster",y = "Cell Type Percentage \n(% of B cells)", fill = "HIV status") +
  facet_wrap(~ tissue, scales = "free", ncol = 2, labeller = labeller(tissue = c(PBMC = "Blood"))) +
  theme_bw +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(size = 15, hjust = 0.5, face = "bold"), 
        axis.text.x = element_text(size = 12, hjust = 1, angle = 45),
        axis.title.x = element_text(size = 14),
        axis.title.y = element_text(size = 14),
        strip.text = element_text(size = 12),
        panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
        panel.grid.minor.y = element_blank(), legend.position = "top")
```

## Fig 3

### Panel A

```{r}
### PCA - CSF group 1 - CSF MBC
# create DESeq objects
object_DESeq2 <- deseq2_CSF_B_gex$DESeq2_objs$`Resting Memory`
pca_cell_type <- "MBC"
pca_tissue <- "CSF"
pca_n_features <- 500

# normalize using vst
dds_vst <- DESeq2::varianceStabilizingTransformation(object_DESeq2, blind = TRUE)

# plot PCA
p1 <- plotPCA(dds_vst, intgroup = "group", ntop = pca_n_features) + 
  ggforce::geom_mark_ellipse(aes(fill = group), alpha = 0.2, expand = unit(0.5,"mm"), size = 0.5) +
  #ggrepel::geom_text_repel(aes(label=name), size=3) +
  coord_cartesian(xlim = c(-14, 22), ylim = c(-9, 13)) +
  scale_color_manual(values = col_HIV_status_PCA, name = "HIV Status",
                     labels = c("control" = "PWoH", "PWH" = "PWH")) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = col_HIV_status_PCA, name = "HIV Status",
                     labels = c("control" = "PWoH", "PWH" = "PWH")) +
  labs(title = paste("PCA of", pca_tissue, pca_cell_type),
       subtitle = paste("CSF group 1")) +
  theme_bw +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(size = 14, hjust = 0.5, face = "bold"),
        plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 13, hjust = 0.5),
        axis.title.x = element_text(size = 14),
        axis.title.y = element_text(size = 14),
        panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
        panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
        panel.grid.minor.x = element_blank(),
        panel.grid.minor.y = element_blank(),
        legend.position = "top",
        plot.margin = unit(c(0.5, 0.5, 0.5, 0.5), "cm"))

# remove objects
rm(pca_cell_type, pca_tissue, dds_vst)
```

### Panel B

```{r}
# set dynamic parameters
title <- "Top 50 Differentially Expressed Genes in CSF MBC Across Participants"
object_DESeq2 <- deseq2_CSF_B_gex$DESeq2_objs$`Resting Memory`

# identify mitochondrial and ribosomal genes
genes_mitochondrial <- grep(pattern = "^MT-", x = rownames(gex_B_ART), value = TRUE) 
genes_ribosomal <- grep(pattern = "^RP[SL][[:digit:]]|^RPLP[[:digit:]]|^RPSA", x = rownames(gex_B_ART), value = TRUE) 
genes_ribosomal <- grep(pattern = "[BK-]|AP|[[:digit:]](.+)L", x = genes_ribosomal, invert = TRUE, value = TRUE)

# set group and genes to display
filt_genes <- deseq2_CSF_B_gex$DE$`Resting Memory` %>% 
  dplyr::filter(p_val_adj < 0.05) %>% 
  dplyr::filter(!gene %in% c(genes_mitochondrial, genes_ribosomal)) %>% 
  arrange(p_val_adj) %>% 
  slice_head(n = 50) %>% 
  pull(gene) %>% unique()
  
# set heatmap annotations
meta.heatmap <- data.frame(object_DESeq2$group, row.names = colnames(counts(object_DESeq2)))
meta.heatmap$object_DESeq2.group <- as.character(meta.heatmap$object_DESeq2.group)
meta.heatmap$object_DESeq2.group[meta.heatmap$object_DESeq2.group == "control"] <- "PWoH"  # rename control group
meta.heatmap$object_DESeq2.group <- factor(meta.heatmap$object_DESeq2.group)
colnames(meta.heatmap) <- "HIV Status"

# prepare matrix for heatmap
norm_counts <- counts(object_DESeq2, normalized = TRUE)
deg_counts <- norm_counts[filt_genes, ]

# set colors
colors <- colorRampPalette(c("navy", "white", "firebrick3"))(100)
colors <- colorRampPalette(c("blue", "white", "red"))(100)
annot_colors <- list("HIV Status" = c("PWH" = "#9e9ac8", "PWoH" = "#41ab5d"))

# plot heatmap of DE genes
ComplexHeatmap::pheatmap(deg_counts,
         scale = "row",
         clustering_method = "ward.D2",
         annotation_col = meta.heatmap,
         annotation_names_col = FALSE,
         show_rownames = TRUE, 
         show_colnames = FALSE,
         fontsize_row = 10,
         fontsize_col = 10,
         fontsize = 10,
         angle_col = "315",
         #cutree_cols = 2,
         cluster_rows = TRUE,
         border_color = NA,
         color = colors,
         legend = TRUE,
         annotation_legend = TRUE,
         annotation_colors = annot_colors,
         heatmap_legend_param = list(title = "Scaled \nExpression"),
         main = title)
```

```{r}
                     "REACTOME_DOWNSTREAM_SIGNALING_EVENTS_OF_B_CELL_RECEPTOR_BCR",
                     "REACTOME_ADAPTIVE_IMMUNE_SYSTEM")

pathways_IFN <- c("REACTOME_INTERFERON_SIGNALING",
                     "REACTOME_INTERFERON_GAMMA_SIGNALING", 
                     "REACTOME_INTERFERON_ALPHA_BETA_SIGNALING",
                     "REACTOME_DDX58_IFIH1_MEDIATED_INDUCTION_OF_INTERFERON_ALPHA_BETA")

pathways_cytokines <- c("REACTOME_GENE_AND_PROTEIN_EXPRESSION_BY_JAK_STAT_SIGNALING_AFTER_INTERLEUKIN_12_STIMULATION",
                     "REACTOME_INTERLEUKIN_12_FAMILY_SIGNALING",
                     "REACTOME_INTERLEUKIN_12_SIGNALING",
                     "REACTOME_INTERLEUKIN_4_AND_INTERLEUKIN_13_SIGNALING", 
                     "REACTOME_INTERLEUKIN_3_INTERLEUKIN_5_AND_GM_CSF_SIGNALING",
                     "REACTOME_SIGNALING_BY_INTERLEUKINS",
                     "REACTOME_INTERLEUKIN_1_SIGNALING",
                     "REACTOME_INTERLEUKIN_1_FAMILY_SIGNALING",
                     "REACTOME_TNF_SIGNALING",
                     "REACTOME_CYTOKINE_SIGNALING_IN_IMMUNE_SYSTEM",
                     "REACTOME_SIGNALING_BY_TGFB_FAMILY_MEMBERS",
                     "REACTOME_SIGNALING_BY_TGF_BETA_RECEPTOR_COMPLEX")

pathways_viral <- c( "REACTOME_INFECTIOUS_DISEASE",
                     "REACTOME_VIRAL_INFECTION_PATHWAYS",
                     "REACTOME_HIV_INFECTION",
                     "REACTOME_HIV_LIFE_CYCLE",
                     "REACTOME_HOST_INTERACTIONS_OF_HIV_FACTORS",

                     "REACTOME_SARS_COV_2_HOST_INTERACTIONS",
                     "REACTOME_SARS_COV_2_MODULATES_HOST_TRANSLATION_MACHINERY"
                     )

# Create the data frame
pathways_categorized <- data.frame(
  ID = c(pathways_adaptive,
         pathways_IFN,
         pathways_cytokines,
         pathways_viral),
  category = c(rep("Antigen Presentation & Adaptive Signaling", length(pathways_adaptive)),
               rep("Interferons", length(pathways_IFN)),
               rep("Cytokine Signaling", length(pathways_cytokines)),
               rep("Viral Infections", length(pathways_viral))))

# subset GSEA
GSEAres_CSF_discov@result <- GSEAres_CSF_discov@result %>% 
  dplyr::filter(ID %in% c(pathways_adaptive, pathways_IFN, pathways_cytokines, pathways_viral))
```

```{r}
add_umap_axes <- function(plot, 
                          axis_start = c(0, 0), 
                          axis_length = 0.1,
                          label_offset = c(0.024, 0.024),
                          arrow_size = 0.3,
                          line_size = 0.5,
                          text_size = 3) {
  
  # Make sure we're working with a ggplot object
  if (!inherits(plot, "ggplot")) {
    stop("Input must be a ggplot object")
  }
  
  # Extract the data from the plot
  plot_data <- ggplot_build(plot)
  
  # Find which layer contains the point data (should be the first layer for DimPlot)
  data_layer <- which(sapply(plot_data$data, function(d) "x" %in% names(d) && "y" %in% names(d)))[1]
  
  # Get x and y ranges
  x_range <- range(plot_data$data[[data_layer]]$x, na.rm = TRUE)
  y_range <- range(plot_data$data[[data_layer]]$y, na.rm = TRUE)
  
  # Calculate axis positions
  x_start <- x_range[1] + (x_range[2] - x_range[1]) * axis_start[1]
  y_start <- y_range[1] + (y_range[2] - y_range[1]) * axis_start[2]
  x_end <- x_start + (x_range[2] - x_range[1]) * axis_length
  y_end <- y_start + (y_range[2] - y_range[1]) * axis_length
  
  # Create a new plot with the axes added
  plot + 
    geom_segment(data = data.frame(x = c(x_start, x_start), 
                                   y = c(y_start, y_start),
                                   xend = c(x_end, x_start), 
                                   yend = c(y_start, y_end)),
                 aes(x = x, y = y, xend = xend, yend = yend),
                 arrow = arrow(length = unit(arrow_size, "cm")), 
                 size = line_size,
                 inherit.aes = FALSE) +
    annotate("text", x = (x_start+x_end)/2, y = y_start - (y_range[2] - y_range[1]) * label_offset[1], 
             label = "UMAP1", size = text_size) +
    annotate("text", x = x_start - (x_range[2] - x_range[1]) * label_offset[2], y = (y_start+y_end)/2, 
             label = "UMAP2", size = text_size, angle = 90)
}
```

```{r}
comparison_results <- df_csf_meta %>%
  group_by(Analyte) %>%
  # Run Shapiro test pour test for normality
  summarise(
    shapiro_p = if(n_distinct(protein_level) > 1 & n() >= 3) {
                  shapiro.test(protein_level)$p.value 
                } else { 
                  NA_real_ 
                },
  # Many proteins do not have a normal distribution. Therfore, a non-parametric test is more appropriate
  # Run Wilcoxon Test
  p_val = wilcox.test(protein_level ~ HIV_status)$p.value) %>%
  # Correct for Multiple Comparisons (BH / FDR)
  mutate(p_adj = p.adjust(p_val, method = "BH"))

# show significant results
prot_signif <- comparison_results %>% dplyr::filter(p_val < 0.05) %>% pull(Analyte)

# set cytokine labels
```

## Fig 6

### Panel A

```{r}
# Calculate isotype percentages per participant
df_isot <- calc_pcts(data = dplyr::filter(bcr_heavy, !is.na(isotype)), 
                   meta_group_by = c("subject_id", "HIV_status", "tissue", "isotype"), 
                   focus_group = "isotype") %>% 
  dplyr::rename(fraction_iso = Percent) %>%
  group_by(subject_id, HIV_status, isotype) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(delta_fraction = fraction_iso[tissue == "CSF"] - fraction_iso[tissue == "PBMC"])

# Calculate summary statistics by tissue and isotype_group
stats_summary <- df_isot %>%
  dplyr::filter(isotype != "IGHE") %>%
  group_by(tissue, isotype) %>%
  summarize(
    mean_fraction   = mean(fraction_iso, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_fraction     = sd(fraction_iso, na.rm = TRUE),
    median_fraction = median(fraction_iso, na.rm = TRUE),
    Q1 = quantile(fraction_iso, probs = 0.25, na.rm = TRUE),
    Q3 = quantile(fraction_iso, probs = 0.75, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# Perform Wilcoxon test for each isotype_group comparing fraction_iso between tissues
wilcox_results <- df_isot %>%
  dplyr::filter(isotype != "IgE") %>%
  group_by(isotype) %>%
  do(tidy(wilcox.test(fraction_iso ~ tissue, data = .))) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  select(isotype, p.value) %>%
  dplyr::rename(p_value = p.value) %>%
  mutate(p_adj = p.adjust(p_value, method = "BH"))

# Combine the summary statistics for each tissue into one table (wide format) and merge the Wilcoxon test results.
iso_summary <- stats_summary %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = tissue, 
              values_from = c(mean_fraction, sd_fraction, median_fraction, Q1, Q3)) %>%
  left_join(wilcox_results, by = "isotype")

# Reshape the data to long format (assuming your summary table is named 'df')
iso_summary_long <- iso_summary %>%
  select(isotype, mean_fraction_PBMC, mean_fraction_CSF) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = starts_with("mean_fraction_"),
               names_to = "tissue",
               values_to = "mean_fraction") %>%
  mutate(tissue = if_else(tissue == "mean_fraction_PBMC", "PBMC", "CSF"))

# Create the facetted pie chart with percentage labels on each slice
ggplot(iso_summary_long, aes(x = "", y = mean_fraction, fill = isotype)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", width = 1) +
  coord_polar(theta = "y") +
  facet_wrap(~ tissue, labeller = labeller(tissue = c(PBMC = "Blood"))) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = col_isotype) +
  labs(title = "Isotype Frequencies\n", fill = "Isotype") +
  theme_void() +
  # Add percentage labels on each slice
  geom_text(aes(label = ifelse(mean_fraction > 3, paste0(round(mean_fraction, 1), "%"),"")),
            position = position_stack(vjust = 0.5),
            color = "black", size = 4) + 
  theme(plot.title = element_text(size = 16, hjust = 0.5, face = "bold"), 
        strip.text = element_text(face = "bold", size = 14),
        legend.position = "top")
```

```{r}
# Summarize your data
summary_df <- bcr_heavy %>%
  mutate(subject_id = as.character(subject_id)) %>%
  group_by(clone_id_unique, subject_id, HIV_status, tissue) %>%
  #filter(tissue == "CSF") %>%
  summarize(
    total_cells    = n_distinct(cell_id_unique),
    expanded_cells = sum(expanded, na.rm = TRUE),
    shared_cells   = sum(shared_BLD_CSF, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>% 
  group_by(subject_id, HIV_status, tissue) %>%
  summarize(
    n_clones     = n_distinct(clone_id_unique),
    n_singletons = sum(total_cells == 1),
    n_expanded   = sum(expanded_cells > 0), 
    n_shared     = sum(shared_cells > 0)
  ) %>%
  mutate(non_singletons = n_clones - n_singletons,
         percent_non_singleton = round(100 * non_singletons / n_clones, 1))

# Reshape data for the stacked bar plot
summary_long <- summary_df %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(n_singletons, non_singletons),

# Create the plot

  geom_segment(aes(x = subject_id, xend = subject_id, y = 1, yend = n_clones), color = "grey80") +
  geom_point(aes(y = n_clones, color = "Total Clonotypes"), size = 4) +
  geom_point(aes(y = non_singletons, color = "Expanded (>1 cell)"), size = 3) +
  geom_text(aes(y = non_singletons, label = paste0(percent_non_singleton, "%")), 
            vjust = -1, size = 3, fontface = "bold") +

  labs(y = "Number of Clonotypes (Log10 Scale)", 
       x = "Participant",
       title = "Expanded Clonotypes by Participant and Tissue",
       color = "Clonotype Expansion:") +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(legend.position = "top",
        plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 14, face = "bold"),
        axis.text.x = element_text(size = 10),
        axis.text.y = element_text(size = 10),
```

### Panel D

```{r}
# Summarize: count cells per clone per subject and assign categories
exp_clones_data <- bcr_heavy %>%
  filter(tissue == "CSF") %>%
  group_by(subject_id, clone_id_unique) %>%
  summarize(n_cells = n_distinct(cell_id_unique), .groups = "drop") %>%
  # Create a new grouping variable: "Singletons" if only one cell, otherwise keep the clone ID
  mutate(category = if_else(n_cells == 1, "Singletons", clone_id_unique)) %>%
  group_by(subject_id, category) %>%
  summarize(total_cells = sum(n_cells), .groups = "drop") %>%
  group_by(subject_id) %>%
  # Calculate the percentage each category represents out of all cells in the subject
  mutate(percentage = total_cells / sum(total_cells) * 100) %>%
  ungroup()

# Remove subjects that only have singletons
valid_subjects <- exp_clones_data %>%
  group_by(subject_id) %>%
  summarize(has_non_singleton = any(category != "Singletons")) %>%
  filter(has_non_singleton) %>%
  pull(subject_id)

exp_clones_data <- exp_clones_data %>%
  dplyr::filter(subject_id %in% valid_subjects) %>%
  mutate(HIV_status = case_when(
    subject_id %in% c("C2", "C3", "C6") ~ "PWoH",
    subject_id %in% c("P4") ~ "PWH",
    TRUE ~ NA)) %>%
  mutate(HIV_status = factor(HIV_status, levels = c("PWoH", "PWH")))

# Prepare color palette 
unique_categories <- unique(exp_clones_data$category)
expanded_clones <- setdiff(unique_categories, "Singletons")

# Create a named vector for colors
clone_colors <- setNames(
  c("gray90", colorRampPalette(RColorBrewer::brewer.pal(12, "Paired"))(length(expanded_clones))),
  c("Singletons", expanded_clones)
)

# Create Stacked Abundance Plot
ggplot(exp_clones_data, aes(x = subject_id, y = percentage, fill = category)) +
  # Using geom_col to create the stacked bars
  geom_col(color = "white", size = 0.1, width = 0.8) +
  
  # 2. ADD THIS: Labels inside each segment
  geom_text(aes(label = total_cells), 
            position = position_stack(vjust = 0.5), 
            size = 3, 
            color = "black") + # Adjust color to white if segments are very dark
  scale_fill_manual(values = clone_colors) +
  facet_grid(~HIV_status, scales = "free_x", space = "free_x") +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent_format(scale = 1), expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.03))) + 
  labs(
    title = "Distribution of Expanded Clonotypes in the CSF\n",
    y = "Percentage of BCR Repertoire",
    x = "Participant",
    fill = "Clonotype ID") +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 14, face = "bold"),
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 10),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 10),
    strip.text = element_text(size = 12),
    panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
  )
```

### Panel G

```{r}
# Pick one gene and one factor_score:
gene <- "IgG_MBC"
factor_score <- "FS1"

df <- per_subj_ct %>%
  dplyr::select(subject_id, HIV_status, age, educ, all_of(gene), all_of(factor_score)) %>%
  tidyr::drop_na()

colnames(df)[colnames(df) == gene] <- "gene_score"
colnames(df)[colnames(df) == factor_score] <- "factor_score"

# Fit model: does slope differ by HIV_status?
model <- lm(factor_score ~ gene_score + age + educ, data = df)

# Extract stats from linear model
b <- coef(summary(model))["gene_score","Estimate"]
se <- coef(summary(model))["gene_score","Std. Error"]
p <- coef(summary(model))["gene_score","Pr(>|t|)"]
r2 <- summary(model)$adj.r.squared
p_mod <- pf(summary(model)$fstatistic[1],
            summary(model)$fstatistic[2],
            summary(model)$fstatistic[3],
            lower.tail = FALSE)

# Spearman correlation
sp <- cor.test(df$gene_score, df$factor_score, method="spearman")

# Create text annotation
annot_text <- paste0(
  "Spearman ρ = ", round(sp$estimate,2), ", p = ", signif(sp$p.value,3), "\n",
  "β = ", round(b,2), " (SE: ", round(se,2), "), p = ", signif(p,3), "\n",
  "Adj-R² = ", round(r2,2), ", p = ", signif(p_mod,3)
)

# Plot
ggplot(df, aes(x = gene_score, y = factor_score, color = HIV_status)) +
  geom_point(shape = 19, size = 4.5, stroke = 0.4) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm",
              se = TRUE, color = "black") +
  annotate("label", x = min(df$gene_score), y = max(df$factor_score),
           label = annot_text, hjust = 0, vjust = 4, size = 4.5,
           color = "black", fontface = "plain") +
  scale_x_continuous(labels = scales::percent_format(accuracy = 1)) +
  scale_color_manual(values = col_HIV_status_PCA, labels = c("control" = "PWoH", "PWH" = "PWH")) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold", size = 14),
        plot.subtitle = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 13),
        axis.title = element_text(size = 14),
        axis.text = element_text(size = 14), 
        legend.text = element_text(size = 15),
        legend.title = element_text(size = 15, face = "bold"),
        legend.position = "top") +
  labs(title = NULL, #"Somatic Hypermutation (SHM) and Cognitive Performance",
       subtitle = NULL, #"Adjusted for age and education",
       x = "SHM difference between CSF and Blood",
       y = "Processing Speed & Excecutive Function \n(Factor Score 1)",
       color = "HIV Status")
```

```{r}
# customize labels
GSEAres_custom_labels_CP <- customize_pathway_labels(GSEAres_CP)

# create dataframe with additional significant pathways in CP
ids_antigen <- c(
  "REACTOME_ANTIGEN_PROCESSING_UBIQUITINATION_PROTEASOME_DEGRADATION")

ids_viral <- c(
  "REACTOME_HCMV_EARLY_EVENTS",
  "REACTOME_LATE_SARS_COV_2_INFECTION_EVENTS")

CP_add <- data.frame(
  ID = c(ids_antigen, ids_viral),
  category = c(
    rep("Antigen Presentation & Adaptive Signaling", length(ids_antigen)),
    rep("Viral Infections", length(ids_viral))),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

# add pathways to existing dataframe
pathways_categorized_CP <- bind_rows(pathways_categorized, CP_add)

# create dataframes for CSR group 1 and 2
plot_dots_CP <- GSEAres_custom_labels_CP@result %>%
  left_join(pathways_categorized_CP, by = "ID") %>%
  dplyr::filter(category %in% c("Antigen Presentation & Adaptive Signaling", "Interferons", "Cytokine Signaling", "Viral Infections")) %>%
  mutate(Description = str_replace_all(Description, "_", " "),
         gene_count = str_split(core_enrichment, "/") %>% map_int(length), 
         gene_ratio = gene_count/setSize, 
         cohort = "Choroid Plexus",
         category = factor(category, 
                           levels = c("Antigen Presentation & Adaptive Signaling", "Interferons", 
                                      "Cytokine Signaling", "Viral Infections"))) %>%
  dplyr::filter(qvalue < 0.1)

# order pathways based on gene ration for CSF group 1
desc_order_CP <- plot_dots_CP %>% arrange(gene_ratio) %>% pull(Description)

# combine dataframes for the two cohorts
plot_dots_CP <- plot_dots_CP %>%
  mutate(Description = factor(Description, levels = desc_order_CP))

# plot data
ggplot(plot_dots_CP, aes(x = gene_ratio, y = Description, fill = qvalue)) +
  geom_col(color = "black", width = 0.7) +
  scale_fill_continuous(low = "#e31a1c", high = "#810f7c") +
  scale_y_discrete(labels = function(labels) str_wrap(labels, width = 80), position = "right") +
  facet_grid(category ~ cohort, scales = "free", space = "free_y", switch = "y",
             labeller = labeller(category = label_wrap_gen(width = 30))) +
  labs(
    title    = "Upregulated Pathways in Choroid Plexus B cells of PWH",
    subtitle = "Gene Set Enrichment Analysis - REACTOME Pathways",
    x        = "Gene Ratio",
    y        = "",
    fill     = "FDR q-value") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    plot.title         = element_text(size = 14, hjust = 0.5, face = "bold"),
    plot.subtitle      = element_text(size = 11, hjust = 0.5),
    axis.text.y        = element_text(size = 12, color = "black"),
    axis.text.x        = element_text(size = 9,  color = "black"),
    axis.title.x       = element_text(size = 12),
    strip.text.x       = element_text(size = 12, color = "darkblue", face = "bold"),
    strip.text.y       = element_text(size = 12, color = "darkgreen",  face = "bold"),
    panel.border       = element_rect(color = "black", fill = NA, linewidth = 1),
    panel.grid.major   = element_blank(),

    legend.position    = "left"
  )
```

## Suppl Fig 3

```{r}
# Extract the full results table for "Resting Memory"
res_volcano <- deseq2_CSF_B_gex$DE$`Resting Memory`

# Apply the Mito/Ribo filtering
genes_mitochondrial <- grep(pattern = "^MT-", x = res_volcano$gene, value = TRUE) 
genes_ribosomal <- grep(pattern = "^RP[SL][[:digit:]]|^RPLP[[:digit:]]|^RPSA", x = res_volcano$gene, value = TRUE)
genes_ribosomal <- grep(pattern = "[BK-]|AP|[[:digit:]](.+)L", x = genes_ribosomal, invert = TRUE, value = TRUE)

res_volcano_filtered <- res_volcano %>%
  dplyr::filter(!gene %in% c(genes_mitochondrial, genes_ribosomal))

# Sort filtered results by adjusted p-value and take the top 20
top_genes_to_label <- res_volcano_filtered %>%
  arrange(p_val_adj) %>%
  slice_head(n = 20) %>%
  pull(gene)

# Define thresholds
fc_cutoff <- 0      
pval_cutoff <- 0.05   

# Create grouping column
df_plot <- res_volcano_filtered %>%
  mutate(diffexpressed = case_when(
    p_val_adj < pval_cutoff & avg_logFC > fc_cutoff ~ "Upregulated",
    p_val_adj < pval_cutoff & avg_logFC < -fc_cutoff ~ "Downregulated",
    TRUE ~ "NS"
  ))

# Select Labels (Top 20 significant genes)
top_genes_data <- df_plot %>%
  filter(gene %in% top_genes_to_label)

# Plot
ggplot(df_plot, aes(x = avg_logFC, y = -log10(p_val_adj), color = diffexpressed)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.7, size = 2) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = c(-fc_cutoff, fc_cutoff), linetype = "dashed", color = "black", linewidth = 0.4) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(pval_cutoff), linetype = "dashed", color = "black", linewidth = 0.4) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Downregulated" = "blue", 
                                "Upregulated" = "red", 
                                "NS" = "darkgrey")) +
  ggrepel::geom_label_repel(data = top_genes_data, 
                   aes(label = gene),
                   fill = "white",         # Background of the box
                   color = "black",        # Text color
                   segment.color = "black",# Line color
                   size = 3.0,
                   box.padding = 0.4,
                   point.padding = 0.3,
                   max.overlaps = Inf,     # Force all labels to show
                   min.segment.length = 0, 
                   show.legend = FALSE) +
  coord_cartesian(xlim = c(-2.2, 2.2), ylim = c(0, 6)) + 
  theme_bw() +
  labs(title = "HIV-related Transcriptomic Changes of\nCSF Resting Memory B Cells",
       subtitle = "Changes observed in PWH (reference: PWoH)",
       x = bquote(~Log[2] ~ "Fold Change"),
       y = bquote(~-Log[10] ~ "FDR"),
       color = "Significance") +
  theme(legend.position = "none",
        plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 14, hjust = 0.5),
        plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 13, hjust = 0.5),
        axis.title = element_text(size = 14))
```

### Panel B

```{r}
# define list with gene sets
gene_sets <- list(Activation = b_cell_activation_genes, Migration = migration_genes, Chemokines = chemokine_genes)

# refine the column groups used for filtering
C_cols <- c("C1", "C2", "C3", "C4", "C5", "C6")
P_cols <- c("P2", "P3", "P4", "P5", "P6", "P7", "P8")

# Initialize a list to store matrices for each gene set and a vector to record row counts
matrix_list <- list()
row_counts <- c()

# Loop through each gene set to compute average expression, filter, and store the matrix
for (set_name in names(gene_sets)) {
    avg_exp <- AverageExpression(
        assays = "RNA",
        subset(gex_B_ART, subset = annotated_clusters_B == "Resting Memory" & tissue == "CSF"), 
        features = gene_sets[[set_name]], 
        group.by = "subject_id"
    )
    
    # Transform to matrix and convert zeros to NA
    gene_matrix <- as.matrix(avg_exp$RNA)
    gene_matrix[gene_matrix == 0] <- NA
    
    # Count non-NA values for each gene in the three groups
    count_C      <- rowSums(!is.na(gene_matrix[, C_cols]))
    count_P  <- rowSums(!is.na(gene_matrix[, P_cols]))
    
    # Keep genes with at least 3 non-NA values in both groups
    gene_matrix <- gene_matrix[count_C >= 3 & count_P >= 3, ]
    
    # Store the processed matrix and record the number of genes
    matrix_list[[set_name]] <- gene_matrix
    row_counts <- c(row_counts, nrow(gene_matrix))
}

# Combine all gene set matrices into one (row-binding them)
combined_matrix <- do.call(rbind, matrix_list)

# Determine row gaps to separate the gene sets in the heatmap.
gaps_row <- cumsum(row_counts)[-length(row_counts)]

# Create a row annotation to label gene set membership
gene_set_labels <- rep(names(matrix_list), times = row_counts)
row_annotation <- data.frame(GeneSet = gene_set_labels)
rownames(row_annotation) <- rownames(combined_matrix)

# Create column annotation based on subject IDs
subject_ids <- colnames(combined_matrix)
group_labels <- ifelse(subject_ids %in% C_cols, "PWoH", 
                              ifelse(subject_ids %in% P_cols, "PWH", NA))
annotation_col <- data.frame(SubjectGroup = group_labels)
rownames(annotation_col) <- subject_ids

# Create a factor with the desired order
desired_levels <- c("PWoH", "PWH")
# Order indices based on the factor
order_index <- order(factor(group_labels, levels = desired_levels))
# Reorder the combined matrix and the annotation accordingly
combined_matrix <- combined_matrix[, order_index, drop = FALSE]
annotation_col <- annotation_col[order_index, , drop = FALSE]
group_labels <- group_labels[order_index]

# Determine the column gaps.
# One gap after the last column of group "Controls" and one after "Psupp"
gap_col1 <- max(which(group_labels == "PWoH"))
gap_cols <- c(gap_col1)

# Plot the heatmap with both row and column annotations and gaps
ComplexHeatmap::pheatmap(
  combined_matrix,
  main = " ",
  fontsize = 8,
  cluster_rows = FALSE,
  cluster_cols = FALSE,
  show_rownames = TRUE,   
  show_colnames = FALSE,
  scale = "row",
  annotation_names_row = FALSE,
  annotation_names_col = FALSE,
  na_col = "lightgrey",
  color = colorRampPalette(c("steelblue", "white", "red"))(100),
  gaps_row = gaps_row,      # gap between PWoH/PWH in rows
  gaps_col = gap_cols,      # gaps between gene‐sets in columns
  annotation_row = row_annotation,
  annotation_col = annotation_col,
  heatmap_legend_param = list(title = "Scaled \nExpression")
)

# remove objects
rm(count_C, count_P, gene_matrix, row_counts, combined_matrix, gaps_row, gap_cols, gene_set_labels, annotation_col, row_annotation)
```

```{r}
# Compute the median frequency per cluster and tissue for reordering purposes

  group_by(cluster, tissue, HIV_status) %>% 
  summarize(n_cells = sum(cell_count), .groups = "drop") %>%

# plot frequencies

  scale_color_manual(values = col_HIV_status_PCA, guide = "none") +
```

### Panels C & D

```{r}
# Light chain usage and capture per participant
light_usage_all <- bcr_data %>% 
  group_by(cell_id_unique, locus, subject_id, tissue, HIV_status) %>% 
  summarize(count = n()) %>% 
  spread(key = locus, value = count, fill = 0) %>%
  mutate(IGK = ifelse(IGK > 1, 1, IGK), 
         IGL = ifelse(IGL > 1, 1, IGL)) %>%
  mutate(light_group = case_when(
    IGK == 0 & IGL == 0 ~ "none", 
    IGK == 1 & IGL == 0 ~ "kappa",
    IGK == 0 & IGL == 1 ~ "lambda", 
    IGK == 1 & IGL == 1 ~ "both",
    TRUE ~ NA
  )) %>%
  group_by(subject_id, tissue, HIV_status, light_group) %>%
  summarize(count = n()) %>%
  group_by(subject_id, HIV_status, tissue) %>%
  mutate(fraction = count / sum(count)) %>%
  ungroup()

p3 <- ggplot(light_usage_all, aes(x = subject_id, y = fraction, fill = light_group)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity") +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent) +
  facet_wrap("tissue", nrow = 2, labeller = labeller(tissue = c(PBMC = "Blood"))) +
  labs(x = "Participant", y = "Frequency", title = "Lambda Chain Usage", fill = "Light Chain Type") +
  theme_bw +
  theme(axis.title = element_text(size = 12),
        axis.text.x = element_blank(),
        axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
        strip.text = element_text(size = 12),
        plot.title = element_text(size = 14, hjust = 0.5, face = "bold"))

# light chain usage comparison across groups
ratio_data <- bcr_data %>%
  group_by(tissue, HIV_status, subject_id, locus, productive) %>%
  summarize(count = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
  spread(key = locus, value = count, fill = 0) %>%
  mutate(lambda_fraction = IGL / (IGK + IGL), 
         kappa_fraction = IGK / (IGK + IGL),
         group = paste0(HIV_status, "_", tissue))

p4 <- ggplot(ratio_data, aes(x = group, y = lambda_fraction, fill = group)) +
  geom_boxplot(outliers = FALSE) +
  geom_jitter(width = 0.2, alpha = 0.3) +
  stat_compare_means(method = "anova", size = 4, label.y = max(ratio_data$lambda_fraction) * 1.05) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("control_CSF" = "#c7e9c0", "PWH_CSF" = "#bcbddc", "control_PBMC" = "#006d2c", "PWH_PBMC" = "#6a51a3"), 
                    labels = c("control_CSF" = "CSF PWoH", "PWH_CSF" = "CSF PWH", "control_PBMC" = "Blood PWoH", "PWH_PBMC" = "Blood PWH")) +
  labs(x = "", y = "Lambda Fraction", fill = "Tissue & HIV status", title = "Lambda Chain Usage \nby HIV Status and Tissue") +
  facet_wrap(~ productive, labeller = labeller(productive = c("TRUE" = "B cells"))) +
  theme_bw +
  theme(axis.title.y = element_text(size = 12),
        axis.text.x = element_blank(),
        axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
        strip.text = element_text(size = 12), 
        plot.title = element_text(size = 14, hjust = 0.5, face = "bold"))
```
